# Fiendish Resilience (`features:fiend-patron-fiendish-resilience`)
**Class:** [Warlock](../classes/warlock.md) | **Subclass:** [Fiend Patron](../subclasses/fiend-patron.md) | **Level:** [Warlock 10](../levels/warlock-10.md)

Choose one damage type, other than Force, whenever you finish a Short or Long Rest. You have Resistance to that damage type until you choose a different one with this feature.
